lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Wow, everyone has such distinct personalities!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: The Counters' chocolate,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: and the ones made by the group at the courthouse, are so out of this world.
Things I'd rather not dwell on, for more reasons than one.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Hehe, is that so? I just find them fascinating since they're so out of the ordinary.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I almost felt bad stealing them...
Don't. If we hadn't stolen them,
I would've died, not from spoiled ingredients, but for entirely different reasons.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Huh?
Anyway, who's next?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Ah, this is where...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: the Underworld Queens are gathering!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Hmm... this isn't going to be easy.
Yeah. Yet another way we could die...
If we get caught, they'll probably riddle us with bullets.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Th-they sound like really dangerous people...

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Even so, we must go.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: To uphold justice, no matter the danger or hardship.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: That is the spirit of the Thieves of Justice.
Yeah, but we're the Thieves of Chocolate, so maybe we don't—

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: You're right! We're the Thieves of Chocolate, carrying on the legacy of the Thieves of Justice!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: We have to make sure innocent people don't get sick!
... All right. Let's go.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Hey. Snake.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: There are plenty of seats over there. Can you move away from me?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Didn't we agree not to cross each other's lines barely ten minutes ago?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Ha! ♡ Who says I crossed anyone's line?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: If anything, you're edging on mine!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Aaahhh...!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: It looks like it's taking shape... b-but are you sure this is how you're supposed to make it?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: You're all being too noisy.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Is it truly impossible for you people to do this with a little civility?
Viper's here too... Umm, do you think it's possible?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Y-yeah... they look pretty intimidating. Do you think we can actually succeed?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Well, no one's perfect at every second.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: An opening will surely present itself.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: And that's when we strike.
... Fine. Let's just wait and see.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: And come on, "Snake?"

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You're the ones who specially invited me to help you make chocolates as a teacher.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Speak with some respect, will you?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You make it sound like you're volunteering your services.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Let's be honest. You're here because you want to give Mister chocolates, not to help us.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: We had to beg Enikk to grant us special permission to come to the Outpost for just one day—on February 14, Valentine's Day.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: on the condition that we, the three Underworld Queens, would be under supervision at all times,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: and that the moment we touched a gun, we'd be executed on the spot.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I know. That's why I'm thankful.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: ... But did you really get Enikk's permission?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I never thought I would ever be allowed to leave the Outer Rim...

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Who knows? Maybe Enikk's starting to develop some human emotions, too.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Oh, don't joke around.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Were there any other conditions you guys agreed to?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I just promised to help Enikk out with a few things when needed.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I won't claim it'll be easy, but I don't think it's unreasonable either.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Maybe it's because Cadet's at the Outpost, and Enikk trusts him and us enough to allow it?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Like Rosanna said, maybe Enikk's developed some feelings for us too.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Feelings? Pfft.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: In the grand scheme of things, she probably doesn't think the Outpost is a part of the Ark.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Let's not get too excited. We can only stay here until 23:59:59 today.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Let's not be late heading back.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Of course. I don't want to miscalculate the timing and get myself killed.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'll play my role as a teacher well, then go back down.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Well, judging by all this chit-chat, looks like everyone's doing a decent job of making this thing.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Is it finished?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Already?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: But of course.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Wait, but I'm not done yet!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Why don't we do a little progress check, then? Let's see who's faring the best.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I'm fine with that.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Yes. knocking your opponent's confidence down a peg sounds like a good idea.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I'll go first.
Sakura places a cherry-blossom-shaped chocolate on the table.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Oooh, cherry blossoms! Great job!

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hmph, you used a store-bought cherry-blossom mold, didn't you?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: ... That is correct.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I knew it. That shape looked familiar.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: If you're going with a flower, you could've at least decorated it a bit better, add some petal details or something.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Looks like you just poured melted chocolate into the mold and let it set.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Can you even consider that handmade?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: True. At this point, it's not all that different from factory-made chocolate, is it?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Hey, you guys don't have to be that harsh...

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I wonder if you possess the skill to judge others so freely.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Fine. As the teacher, I'll show mine.
Viper places a sleek chocolate shaped like a coiled serpent.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Wow! You guys are seriously talented!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: How did you even make the snake?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: This much effort is the bare minimum when it comes to making handmade chocolates ♡

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: That way, Honey's bound to like it, right?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You're so full of yourself. You just had to make something that's about you.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Haha, if you stack two of them on top of each other, it looks like a pile of poop.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Indeed it does.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Incorporating multiple layers, would've left an even stronger impression. What a shame.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Let's see how good yours is, if you're going to talk trash.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Try not to be too surprised.
Rosanna places a square slab of chocolate engraved with an ornate rose.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What, seriously?! Why is everyone this good?!
Moran glances discreetly at her own square chocolate sitting at the corner of the table.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Wh-what's wrong with making it a plain old square?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Didn't you hear Viper what said?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: If you want to catch Mister's eye, you'll need something flashy, like a rose.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Poop-snake...?!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Haha. A rose? Oh please.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: It looks like a rat's been chewing on it.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Pfft, pardon me.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Pfft... oops, sorry! Sorry!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Haha! Is that so? That's what you all think?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Fine. Making chocolate isn't my thing anyway.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: This works out nicely.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Rosanna...?
Rosanna pulls out her gun.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I think it's time to thin out the competition.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Hey! It was just a joke. No need to take it this far!
*Click*

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: She has a point.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: It never hurts removing the competition ahead of time.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Sakura, not you too?!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Haha! Called it. You guys held back longer that I expected.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I knew this would happen the moment the three of you said you were gonna be working together.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I don't even carry a gun... Looks like I'm about to get shot for nothing.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: H-huh?!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Y-you guys, seriously, put those guns away!
*Bang*
Rosanna fires a shot into the ceiling beside the vent.
*Gasp*

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Eep!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: A-are you insane?! Wh-what if that actually hit someone?!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I've never gotten along well with rats.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Funny thing is... I heard a rat's been running around the Outpost for the past few hours.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Huh? Th-there's a rat in the Outpost?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: And that rat...

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: feels like it's right above our heads, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What? Over our heads? Wh-where?!

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: If you come down quietly now,

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: we'll let you off with a warning.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Well, I don't mind if it stays hidden a little longer.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Can't it stay hidden a little longer?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: W-wait... you all knew?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Eeeek! Wh-what do we do?! Do we tell them the truth...?
Yeah. If we say it's us, they might not shoot...

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Don't worry.
Delta pulls out shurikens fitted with grenades.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: A ninja thief knows no surrender.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Wh-what are you planning to do...?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Just trust me again this time.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Okay, I'll believe in you...
W-we're counting on you...

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Crust, hand me the chocolates you want to deliver.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: O-okay, here!
Crust hands four chocolates to Delta.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Okay... I'm going in!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: So I'm the only one who didn't know?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Didn't you get a message from Anis and Privaty saying their chocolates were stolen?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Oh, I think I did see something like that...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: It's pretty obvious someone's making hits on the groups that are making chocolates together.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Didn't it cross your mind they'd come for us next?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Moreover, how could you miss all that audible breathing?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: E-even so...!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Shut it. Quit whining and get ready to catch that scum.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Whining?! Hey!!
*Whoosh*
The grenade-fitted shuriken flies from the ceiling and lands on the table.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What the... Is that a shuriken?!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: It's a grenade! Take cover!
*Hisssss*
The grenade split open, releasing a cloud of pale powder.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Aaagh! My eyes!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Ugh! What is this?!

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: *Huff* Everyone, stay alert and watch your surroundings!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Uhh... H-hang on...!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Our chocolates... they're gone!

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: When did they...?!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Tch... if it comes to this...!
Rosanna aims her gun at the ceiling.
*Whoosh* *Thud*

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Argh!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Ow!

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Ugh!
Sakura picks up something that hit her on the head.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: What the hell is this...?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: It looks like... chocolate?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: So they steal chocolate, then leave chocolate behind? Why...?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Haha... This is getting more entertaining by the second.
*Bang*
Rosanna fires another shot toward the ceiling.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: ... Bah. Missed.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I don't sense any presence. It appears they've already escaped.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Tch...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: S-so what do we do? Where are our chocolates...?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Who knows...
Viper carefully examines the wrapper that fell onto her head.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: We'll just have to track them down one way or another.
